items.problem: CS0104 guidance was present but framed only around stale UWP/WinUI XAML namespaces, not SDK implicit-using collisions.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3829-3844: HttpClient was ambiguous between System.Net.Http and Windows.Web.Http.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, 'Common build errors after the namespace rewrite' -> 'CS0104: LaunchActivatedEventArgs is an ambiguous reference'
items.proposed_improvement: Extend the existing CS0104 section to call out implicit .NET usings, fully qualifying the intended API family, and avoiding a global implicit-using disable for one collision.
items.generalizes: SDK-style WinUI projects enable implicit usings, so retained Windows API types can collide with modern .NET types in many migrations.
